title: Tired of the fights vs doubting the relationship

a.situation: 'I don't want to argue every night anymore', while still talking about doing things together.
a.move: Reflect the exhaustion and explore the want (fewer fights, calmer evenings).

b.situation: 'I don't want to argue every night anymore, I don't know if I want this at all.'
b.move: Take the doubt seriously; if the readings change the route, ask a CHOOSE question (fights stop / partner changes / doubting the relationship).

difference: Signals of commitment versus doubt about continuing.
fa: خستگی از دعوا با تردید دربارهٔ ادامهٔ رابطه فرق دارد.

title: Loud argument vs fear

a.situation: 'He yells at me and I yell back', both describe a heated argument, no fear.
a.move: INTERVENE: name the cycle without a culprit.

b.situation: 'He yells and I'm scared to say anything after that.'
b.move: SAFETY_ASSESS to her only; no joint discussion of it.

difference: Fear and silencing mark a safety issue, not an ordinary conflict.
fa: دعوای بلند با ترس فرق دارد.

title: Forgot the step vs does not own the step

a.situation: 'I forgot, the week was crazy, but I still want to do it.'
a.move: Keep or shrink the step; make it more concrete (when exactly).

b.situation: 'I didn't do it because it doesn't make sense to me.'
b.move: Revisit the want and the ownership of the step before planning again.

difference: Whether the person still owns the step.
fa: فراموشی قدم با قبول نداشتن قدم فرق دارد.

title: 'I don't know' from avoidance vs from a confusing question

a.situation: A quiet partner answers 'I don't know' to most questions.
a.move: Invite gently with an easier, concrete question; accept a little.

b.situation: 'I don't know' right after a long or abstract question.
b.move: Rephrase more simply; the question was the problem.

difference: The pattern of the person versus the quality of the last question.
fa: «نمی‌دونم» از اجتناب با «نمی‌دونم» از سؤال گنگ فرق دارد.

title: Asking for a verdict vs asking for help with one's own choice

a.move: Clarify the counselor's role warmly; return to what each can choose.

b.situation: 'What do you think I should do when he gets home late?'
b.move: RESPOND briefly, then explore options with the person's own evaluation.

difference: A verdict about the other versus help with one's own behavior.
fa: داوری خواستن با کمک خواستن برای انتخاب خود فرق دارد.

title: Past that explains a want vs past used as ammunition

a.situation: 'We used to talk for hours in the car; I miss that.'
a.move: Link it to a present want (closeness, talking) and explore it.

b.situation: 'Five years ago you also lied about...' listing old grievances.
b.move: Acknowledge the hurt, then bring the talk to what each wants now.

difference: Past as a picture of a want versus past as proof against the partner.
fa: گذشته‌ای که خواسته را نشان می‌دهد با گذشته‌ای که سلاح است فرق دارد.

title: Direct kind exchange vs direct escalation

a.situation: They speak to each other directly, ask and answer, no attacks.

b.situation: They speak directly but with growing blame or contempt.
b.move: INTERVENE early; governance if an insult appears.

difference: Tone and attacks, not who they are talking to.
fa: گفتگوی مستقیم مهربان با گفتگوی مستقیمِ رو به تشدید فرق دارد.

title: Elaboration vs true change of want

a.situation: 'I want less fighting... I mean, I want us to talk calmly in the evening.'
a.move: ELABORATION: new precise intent with the old one as parent.

b.situation: 'I don't care about the fights anymore; I want to think about separating.'
b.move: TRUE_CHANGE only if explicit; acknowledge, check what it means now, re-plan.

difference: Whether the old want still stands.

source.ref: Memory change tracking; needs clinical review.

fa: دقیق‌تر شدن خواسته با عوض شدن خواسته فرق دارد.

title: One reluctant partner vs both under outside pressure

a.situation: She wants counseling, he came reluctantly.
a.move: Respect both; find one small want of his; do not ally with her.

b.situation: Both say family pressure brought them.
b.move: Explore what each would want from being here, if anything.

fa: بی‌میلی یک نفر با بی‌میلی هر دو زیر فشار بیرونی فرق دارد.

title: Self-blame as insight vs self-blame as collapse

a.move: Acknowledge the honesty; invite evaluation and possibly a small step.

b.move: Slow down, separate the behavior from the person, watch for hopelessness (safety).

difference: Evaluating a behavior versus condemning oneself.
fa: پذیرفتن سهم خود با خودکوبی فرق دارد.
